en.name: God of Ug
en.ability: One Ug hat. When wearing the Ug hat, you must speak one sound at a time but vote twice. If you fail, pass the Ug hat.

zh.name: Ug 之神
zh.ability: 只有一顶 Ug 帽子。戴着 Ug 帽子时，你每次只能发出一个声音，但拥有两票。若你失败了，传递 Ug 帽子。
